business_problem: With clients ranging from higher education institutions to advocacy groups, NextAfter strives to provide high-level, multi-channel insights. The challenge? Doing so with a two-person data team that supports a broader client services team.
solution_summary: This has had a profound impact on the speed of development. A meta-optimizer tool that previously lingered in the prototyping phase was coded and standardized for Google Cloud in just six hours using the Gemini Data Engineering Agent in BigQuery. Similarly, Gemini helped rebuild a data pipeline that queries 55 different Google Analytics sources, reducing the run time from 20 minutes to just two. Beyond data unification, NextAfter has transitioned to Google Workspace with Gemini and Gemini Enterprise , which acts as a force multiplier for the company's lean team. Using Agent Developer Kit, a no-code agent builder, the team also created "Winston AI." This agent sits on top of the company's experiment database—called Winston—to help account leads brainstorm new A/B testing ideas based on historical learnings.
